## CommandUncertainty interface

An interpretation boundary whose contents the selected Go syntax model leaves opaque. This does not claim a hidden command exists; it prevents an empty represented subtree from being mistaken for evidence that no further execution is possible.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export interface CommandUncertainty
```
